about: Royal Throne areas, restored with stars as in Royal Match (structure only; all names, scenes and art are original). Costs are stars per task; regions are polygons in scene pixels (x right, y down). Areas without regions wait for their generated scene. The pipeline in tools/ turns this file plus the art into Assets/JellyGarden/Resources/RoyalAreas.
style: Bright, polished cartoon 3D mobile casual game scene in portrait 9:16, the same art style as the Royal Throne castle approach: soft warm sunlight, royal blue, gold and cream palette, crisp stylized details, gentle depth of field. No text, no letters, no people, no characters, no animals, no UI. The top 20% is open sky or ceiling, the bottom 25% is a clear floor or ground in the foreground, and the scene's feature objects stand well apart across the middle of the frame.

areas.name: Castle Approach
areas.subtitle: Welcome the kingdom home
areas.scene: EXISTING: the approved Home castle (Homepage_bg.png, supplied by the user) is this area's restored view.

tasks.name: Raise the castle keep
tasks.before: a half-built castle keep of bare pale stone walls with wooden scaffolding and ropes, no roofs, no towers' spires, no flags and no banners

tasks.name: Rebuild the grand stairway
tasks.before: broken, crumbled stone steps with cracks, loose rubble and small weeds, the balustrades fallen

tasks.name: Restore the twin waterfalls
tasks.before: dry grey rock cliffs with no water, empty stone basins and a few dry shrubs

tasks.name: Set the golden gate pillars
tasks.before: the toppled ruins of a stone gate pillar: a cracked low base with broken stone blocks, no golden sphere and no banner

tasks.name: Pave the sunlit plaza
tasks.before: cracked, dusty and broken paving stones with patches of bare earth, weeds and small puddles

tasks.name: Plant the courtyard gardens
tasks.before: bare brown earth with dry twigs and pebbles, no bushes and no flowers

areas.name: Queen's Rose Garden
areas.subtitle: Bloom for the Queen
areas.scene: The Queen's walled rose garden behind the castle: a tall rose-covered arch at the back centre, a round white marble fountain in the middle, low clipped hedge-maze rows on the left, two carved white garden benches on the right, a small swan pond with lily pads at the lower left, and rows of red and pink rose beds along the lower right. Blue sky above with a far castle tower behind the garden wall.

tasks.name: Build the rose arch
tasks.before: a bare, broken trellis frame with dead vines

tasks.name: Restore the marble fountain
tasks.before: a cracked, dry fountain bowl full of dead leaves

tasks.name: Plant the rose beds
tasks.before: empty soil beds with a few weeds

areas.name: Throne Hall
areas.subtitle: A seat worthy of the King
areas.scene: The castle's grand throne hall seen from the entrance: a golden royal throne on a raised dais at the back centre under a blue canopy, a long crimson carpet running from the foreground to the dais, a crystal chandelier hanging high in the middle, tall stained-glass windows on the back wall, royal blue and gold banners on the side walls, white marble pillars on both sides, and golden candelabras beside the carpet.

tasks.name: Restore the royal throne
tasks.before: an empty stone dais with a broken wooden chair

tasks.name: Hang the crystal chandelier
tasks.before: a bare iron hook and a dangling chain

tasks.name: Raise the realm's banners
tasks.before: bare wall with empty banner poles

areas.name: Royal Stables
areas.subtitle: Stalls fit for royal steeds
areas.scene: The royal stables courtyard: a long wooden stable building with arched blue doors at the back, a hay loft with golden hay above, an ornate royal carriage in the middle, a stone water trough at the lower left, a tall horseshoe-shaped stone arch on the right, lantern posts along a cobbled path, wooden saddle racks by the wall, and a golden weather vane on the stable roof. Blue sky above.

tasks.name: Restore the royal carriage
tasks.before: a broken cart frame with a missing wheel

tasks.name: Hang the saddle racks
tasks.before: a bare wall with empty pegs

areas.name: Grand Ballroom
areas.subtitle: Music for a royal night
areas.scene: The castle's grand ballroom: a gleaming patterned dance floor in the foreground and middle, a raised orchestra stage at the back with music stands, a white and gold grand piano on the left, a wall of tall gilded mirrors at the back, two sparkling chandeliers above, blue velvet curtains with gold tassels, an upper balcony with a balustrade, and a long banquet table with a white cloth and golden goblets on the right.

areas.name: Knights' Armory
areas.subtitle: Ready the King's guard
areas.scene: The knights' armory: stone walls with wooden weapon racks of polished swords and spears, gleaming suits of armor on stands, a wall of round painted shields, a glowing forge with an anvil at the back right, straw training dummies, a tall banner stand, iron-bound armor chests, arched windows with blue sky, and a round wooden table in the middle foreground.

tasks.name: Hang the shield wall
tasks.before: a bare stone wall with empty hooks

tasks.name: Place the round table
tasks.before: an empty floor with scattered planks

areas.name: Starwatch Observatory
areas.subtitle: Chart the kingdom's stars
areas.scene: The castle's star observatory at dusk: a great brass telescope under an opening dome, a large celestial globe on a gold stand, dome shutters open to a violet starry sky at the top, a round map table with star charts, a spiral stone stair on the left, a crystal orrery of planets, hanging moon-shaped lanterns, curved shelves of scrolls, a carved astronomer's desk, and potted night-blooming flowers in the foreground.

tasks.name: Build the brass telescope
tasks.before: an empty mount and loose brass tubes

areas.name: Harbor Lighthouse
areas.subtitle: Guide the ships home
areas.scene: The kingdom's harbor on a sunny day: a tall white and blue lighthouse with a golden lamp on the right, a stone pier running into turquoise water, a royal sailboat with blue and gold sails at the dock, fishing nets on wooden frames, colorful market stalls with awnings, stacked cargo crates and barrels, a bronze harbor bell on a post, a lantern-lined path, a small boat house, and a dune garden of grasses in the foreground. Blue sky above.

tasks.name: Light the lantern path
tasks.before: bare posts along a rough path

areas.name: Crystal Winter Garden
areas.subtitle: Frost that sparkles like jewels
areas.scene: A royal glass winter garden: a great glass dome above, an ice fountain in the centre, frosted silver trees, a crystal arch, glowing snow lanterns, beds of white and blue winter roses, a small frozen skating pond in the foreground, birch benches, glass swan sculptures, a crystal footbridge over a stream, and a tall star-topped tree at the back, all in cool blue, white and gold tones.

areas.name: Treasure Vault
areas.subtitle: The crown jewels of Royal Throne
areas.scene: The royal treasure vault: a huge round golden vault door at the back, heaps of gold coins, a velvet pedestal with a jeweled crown in the centre, glass jewel cases, a stand with a golden scepter, a royal blue tapestry, a small coin fountain, a gem-studded chandelier, two stone guardian statues beside the door, open treasure chests, a table with a royal seal, and a hidden stair behind a sliding panel.
